offering_description.value: Publishes daily legal newspapers and websites covering courts and the legal profession, and runs public notice advertising. Through its Journal Technologies unit, it licenses and implements case management software to courts, prosecutors and justice agencies.

primary_products.value: case management software for courts; legal newspapers; subscription legal news and information

primary_services.value: software implementation and consulting; software maintenance and support; public notice advertising; hosting

customer_segment.value: B2G: courts, prosecutors, public defenders, and justice agencies using case management software; B2B: law firms, attorneys and businesses subscribing to or advertising in legal publications

end_markets.value: government courts and justice; legal services; legal publishing

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: software licenses for case management systems; service fees: software maintenance, support, hosting and implementation; subscription: newspaper and online legal news subscriptions; advertising: public notice and legal advertising in newspapers
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; service fees; subscription; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops case management software sold to courts and government agencies; service provider: publishes legal newspapers and sells public notice advertising to attorneys and businesses

geography_served.value: global: Newspapers in California, Arizona and other US states, software used by courts in the US, Canada, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: court case management software and legal newspaper publishing serving the legal and justice sector

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: software sold to courts and agencies through contracts and bids; online: digital subscriptions and websites for legal news; other: print newspaper subscriptions and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal business rules, public notice advertising laws and government procurement and data security requirements apply
